explanation: Counseling items (timing, grapefruit, no double-dosing, CBC, infection/respiratory symptoms) are supported. But the claim that Ibrance plus endocrine therapy 'can be confidently managed as first-line care' overstates evidence, which only covers counseling/monitoring practices, not efficacy or treatment-line positioning.
suggested_rewrite: With appropriate monitoring and counseling, Ibrance plus endocrine therapy can be administered as prescribed for HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer, following recommended safety monitoring.
